task: E20: cluster-bootstrap 95% CI for the D1/D2 verdicts
method: Out-of-fold score bootstrap: the frozen probe is fit once per cell and the resampling acts on the held-out scores. PREREG §2/§3 implied a refit-per-draw bootstrap, which measured infeasible (13-30 s per fit). Consequence: intervals omit the refit component of the variance (E16 puts that at 2.51 pp). See the module docstring and E20_REPORT.
why: fragile = the 95% interval straddles the decision boundary. The point-estimate verdicts in D1_TALLY/D2_TALLY are NOT retracted by this file.
